record.question:
Statement: Some teachers are strict. All strict teachers are disciplined.

Conclusions:
I. Some teachers are disciplined.
II. All disciplined people are teachers.
options: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows
record.explanation: The teachers known to be strict are disciplined by the second premise. Since some such teachers exist, some teachers are disciplined (I); the stronger converse does not follow. Original printed source and ordered choices independently reviewed. Verified worked solution, unofficial; no matching examiner key is asserted.
record.direction: Direction (Questions 94–96): In each question, a statement is given followed by two conclusions (I and II). Assume everything in the statement to be true and decide which conclusions logically follow.
